exam: 2024年6月 第3套 · 仔细阅读 P2
title: The art of persuasion means convincing others to agree with …

sents.en: The art of persuasion means convincing others to agree with your point of view or to follow your course of action.
sents.cn: 说服的艺术，在于让别人赞同你的观点或遵从你的行动方针。

sents.en: For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally.
sents.cn: 对我们中的一些人而言，说服力是一种本能的特质，影响他人的力量与生俱来。

sents.en: For the rest of us, persuasion skills can be learned and developed over time.
sents.cn: 对我们其余的人而言，说服技巧可以经由学习、随时间培养。

sents.en: Employers place a great value on employees with persuasion skills because they can impact several aspects of job performance.
sents.cn: 雇主十分看重具备说服技巧的员工，因为这些技巧能影响工作表现的多个方面。

sents.en: Besides, teamwork and leadership rely heavily on the power of persuasion to get things done.
sents.cn: 此外，团队协作与领导力高度依赖说服力来把事情办成。

sents.en: Without persuasion skills, employees may not be as committed to or convinced of the importance of an organization's vision and long-term mission.
sents.cn: 若缺了说服技巧，员工或许不会那么投入，也不会那么信服组织愿景与长期使命的重要性。

sents.en: Effective use of persuasion skills will not only help get your coworkers excited about your ideas, it'll also help you motivate them to achieve a common goal.
sents.cn: 有效运用说服技巧，不仅能让你的同事为你的想法感到兴奋，还能助你激励他们去实现共同目标。

sents.en: In order to learn the art of persuasion at the workplace, you need to understand how to handle conflicts and reach agreements.
sents.cn: 要在职场学会说服的艺术，你需要懂得如何处理冲突、达成一致。

sents.en: Good communication is the first step in effective persuasion, but logic and reasoning are just as important.
sents.cn: 良好沟通是有效说服的第一步，但逻辑与推理同样重要。

sents.en: Before you can get somebody on-board with your goal, you should help them understand why they should pursue it.
sents.cn: 在让别人认同你的目标之前，你应先帮他们理解为何要追求它。

sents.en: Using visual aids to back up your ideas can help communicate your ideas better and make compelling arguments so your listeners will come to a logical choice and become fully committed to your ideas and plans.
sents.cn: 用视觉辅助来支撑你的观点，能更好地传达想法、形成有说服力的论证，让你的听众做出合乎逻辑的选择，并全心投入到你的想法与计划之中。

sents.en: Successful persuasion skills are based on your ability to have positive interactions and maintain meaningful relationships with people.
sents.cn: 成功的说服技巧，建立在你与他人积极互动、维系有意义关系的能力之上。

sents.en: In order to sustain those relationships, you must be able to work in their best interests as well.
sents.cn: 要维持这些关系，你也必须能站在他们的最大利益上行事。

sents.en: Your coworkers are more likely to agree with you when they succeed alongside you.
sents.cn: 当同事与你一同获得成功时，他们更可能认同你。

sents.en: The more they achieve and the greater progress they make, the more they trust your judgement and strength.
sents.cn: 他们取得的成就越多、进步越大，就越信任你的判断与能力。

sents.en: We persuade and get persuaded every day · were either convincing or being convinced.
sents.cn: 我们每天都在说服别人，也被别人说服——不是正在说服，就是正在被说服。

sents.en: A vast majority of people prefer collaboration and teamwork over traditional organizational structures, no one likes to be told what to do or to be pushed around.
sents.cn: 绝大多数人偏好协作与团队合作，胜过传统的组织结构；没人喜欢被指使，或被呼来喝去。

sents.en: Therefore, organizations and leaders should adopt powerful persuasion skills to bring about necessary changes.
sents.cn: 因此，组织与领导者应当掌握强大的说服技巧，以促成必要的改变。
